text:
alice_support: Hey team, customer u_58 (acct: redwood-corp) says they redeemed promo code PROMO-SPRING-24; UI shows \"Redeemed\" and they got confirmation email, but their credit balance is still $0. Ticket #7892. Can someone check ledger?
webhooks-bot: webhook delivered to /internal/ledger/webhook id=evt_01Gx2, status=200, body_hash=ab12cd
alice_support: Pasting webhook payload we received:
```
{"event":"promo.redeemed","acct_id":"redwood-corp","code":"PROMO-SPRING-24","amount":20000,"currency":"usd_cents","redeem_id":"rd_9f3b","timestamp":1678901234}
```
alice_support: Customer screenshot: https://redwood.app/screencap/rd7892 — UI shows redeem success and email: \"Your $200 credit has been applied\"
ben_billing: Checked ledger: no transaction for redeem_id rd_9f3b, no allocation_row created. Audit table shows webhook received but processing_step='queued', last_error=NULL, attempts=3.
jordan_engineer: I see recent errors from allocation-worker-3 around that timeframe. Growing redis backlog too. Logs show: `Traceback KeyError: 'allocation_id'` from /srv/allocations/processor.py:142. Likely worker dropped event after exception — webhook was accepted but not idempotently applied.
alice_support: Redis queue length now 412 for queue:promo-redeem; worker pod allocation-worker-3 status CrashLoopBackOff. Dump of last 10 messages shows several identical payloads.
jordan_engineer: Ok. Plan: 1) restart allocation-worker-3 to clear CrashLoopBackOff 2) run a reprocess script to surface unhandled queued events and attempt idempotent apply 3) if any customers still missing credit after reprocess, we can issue manual grants and reconcile later. I'll run restart + dry-run reprocess in prod-safe mode in 10m. Any objections?
emma_support_lead: Approve. Also approve a manual temporary grant to redwood-corp while we reprocess — keep customer unblocked. Ben, can you issue a one-off $200 credit and note transaction id for reconciliation?
ben_billing: Will do. Creating ad-hoc credit tx now. SQL I will run (sanitized):
```
-- create manual credit
INSERT INTO credits (acct_id, amount_cents, reason, created_by) VALUES ('redwood-corp', 20000, 'Emergency grant: promo reprocess delay (ticket #7892)', 'ben_billing');
```
Created tx id tx_202_7892, visible in ledger UI. Note: mark as provisional until we reprocess to avoid double-apply.
jordan_engineer: Restarted allocation-worker-3 (`kubectl rollout restart deploy/allocation-worker-3`), logs showing worker back up. Starting reprocess dry-run against queue (no writes).
jordan_engineer: Dry-run found 6 events including rd_9f3b where allocation_id was missing due to malformed event source. Fixing processor to tolerate missing allocation_id and generate a new one if absent. Patch ready and will be hotfixed with feature flag.
jordan_engineer: Hotfix deployed to allocation service with feature flag `alloc-fix-gen-id=true` in staging then prod. Running reprocess in live mode now.
jordan_engineer: Reprocess applied event rd_9f3b -> allocation created (alloc_7c1). Noting ledger transaction now present and idempotency guard set.
ben_billing: Confirmed ledger shows promo allocation row alloc_7c1 and marks redeem_id rd_9f3b applied. Manual provisional credit tx tx_202_7892 will be reversed to avoid double credit. Reversal tx id tx_rev_202_7892.
alice_support: Thanks everyone — I just messaged the customer: \"We've applied your promo; you should see $200 in credits now. We issued and then reversed a provisional grant while we reprocessed — net single credit applied. Sorry for the hassle\"
emma_support_lead: Good runbook note: add monitoring alert for allocation-worker error rate > 5% and queued promo events > 100. Also add a postmortem entry and correlate with recent deploy 2026-03-14.
alice_support: Adding ticket update and closing once customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
